Technology description including backgro: Primed and painted steel structures are customized construction components for many indoor and outdoor applications, including load-bearing and non-load bearing structures. The steel structures are manufactured according to EN 1090-2, up to EXC 4, and are CE- marked. UN CPC code: 421 Structural metal products and parts thereof. The steel structures of industrial and civil objects are made according to the developed drawings. The manufacturing contains the following processes: • Extraction and delivery of raw materials; • Cutting; • Assembling; • Welding; • Sand blasting; • Coating; • Storage; • Transportation (delivery of finished products). | |
